decisive_items: well-defined isodense intraconal lesion measuring 2.6 × 2.5 × 2.4 mm with intrinsic high-density areas
MRI demonstrated a hyperintense mass on T1-weighted images and hypointense signal on T2-weighted images
response.rationale: Radiographic findings are more consistent with Orbital cavernous hemangioma

rejected.why: Normal anterior and posterior segment examinations without optic nerve signs contradict Scleral Melanoma Metastasis
No direct evidence of metastasis to the orbit is provided
